title: "Rep is active?" tracks the staff-active status, not the toggle
refs: SV-8632 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 15 S15-R6; Story 13 S13-R11)
preconds: 1. Arrange (and afterward restore): one assigned rep whose staff record is ACTIVE but whose sales-representative toggle is OFF, and one assigned rep whose staff record is INACTIVE but whose toggle is ON..
steps:
1. Download the Sales Representative Assignments CSV.
2. Read the "Rep is active?" value on both reps' customer rows.
expected:
1. The staff-ACTIVE / toggle-off rep shows "Rep is active?" = "Yes" — the toggle does not drive this column.
2. The staff-INACTIVE / toggle-on rep shows "Rep is active?" = "No".
3. The value is always "Yes" or "No" (never "Deactivated" or another word).
